## How to run it

[context specification source](https://huggingface.co/IFM/K2-Horizon-7B/blob/036114ce8d46c32b24c15423211069abb9c5d25e/README.md) · Institute of Foundation Models official model card: native 524,288-token context ("512K"). Observed 2026-09-25.

```sh
llama-server -hf IFM/K2-Horizon-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
llama-server -hf IFM/K2-Horizon-7B-GGUF:Q8_0
```
